name: stockflow-plan
description: PLANNING-LANE-ONLY corpus, captured live on the current state machine via `capture-scenario.sh --sprint stockflow-rerecord-s1 --feature F1-stock-visibility --plan-only`. Records exactly the planning turns in the order today's machine derives them: spec-author/propose + architect-reviewer/estimate (both executor-dispatched), product-owner/author-requests (+ sync-backlog), architect-reviewer/estimate-committed, then the plan gate. No design or build turns (buildReplay:false). Replays via `replay-scenario.sh --scenario stockflow-plan --sprint stockflow-rerecord-s1 --plan-only`. Proves the J2 planning lane on the unified executor path; supersedes the stale planning turns in stockflow-rerecord (whose recorded order predates estimate-committed-before-gate-plan).

features.summary: planning only: propose → estimate → author-requests → estimate-committed → gate-plan
